USE OF GIS FOR PROJECTS IN RURAL AREAS 
 
3954  SHRI SUSHIL KUMAR GUPTA:  
 
Will the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether Government has any plan for utilising the Geographic Information System 
(GIS) for improvement in planning and implementation of projects in the rural areas; 
(b)  if so, the details in this regard; 
(c)  if not, the reasons therefor; and 
(d)  the other steps being taken for better planning and implementation of Pradhan Mantri 
Gram Sadak Yojana? 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT 
(SADHVI NIRANJAN JYOTI) 
 
(a) to (c)  The Ministry of Rural Development is utilizing the Geographic Information System 
(GIS) for improvement in planning and implementation of projects. GIS planning is being used 
for Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS) and Pradhan 
Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY).  
Under PMGSY-III, more than 7.70 lakh rural facilities such as medical, educational and markets 
have been geo-tagged. Details of rural roads are available in public domain at https://geosadak-
pmgsy.nic.in/opendata. 
The GIS data created under PMGSY National GIS guideline is not just of 
rural areas, but serves as a holistic national geo-spatial dataset including urban areas, National 
Highways, State Highways and Railway tracks, etc. GeoSadak has been developed utilizing fully 
indigenous GIS data layers and satellite data services.  
Under Mahatma Gandhi NREGS, assets are created across the country related to water 
harvesting, drought relief, flood control activities, sanitation. Satellite derived Location based 
services are being utilized for planning and monitoring of nearly 7-8
  million assets annually 
through the use of mobile-based geo-tagging. Online Geo-spatial maps is available at 
https://bhuvan-app2.nrsc.gov.in/mgnrega/mgnrega_phase2.php. A web GIS based mechanis m 
for creating geotags for all MGNREGA works across the country is very successful and 
presently 3 crore assets are geotagged.  
Under MGNREGS, 2.56 lakh Gram Panchayats (GPs) have prepared the GIS based GP plans as 
on 31st March 2022. Under PMGSY-III, 11537 numbers of sanctioned road proposals (87026.04 
km length) have been drawn on the GIS (GeoSadak) platform.  
 
 
 
341

 
To ensure better transparency in the implementation of the MGNREGS, mobile applications like 
Area Officers' App and National Mobile Monitoring Software have been developed. The first 
one enables officers conducting inspection to record the findings of inspection online. The latter 
enables taking attendance twice a day for every work which has muster roll issued for more than 
20 workers at a time. In all the above apps, geo-tagged time stamped photographs are taken 
which are compared with the GIS coordinates of the site of the relevant work. Similar actions are 
taken at the time of inspecting PMGSY works. 
Assets under Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana- Gramin, Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission 
are also geo-tagged. In the former, 5 geotagged timestamped photographs are taken, to ensure 
that the scheme assistance is not misappropriated by diverting the funds elsewhere. 
(d)  Under the PMGSY, entire District Rural Road Plan (DRRP), Habitation and important 
socio-economic facilities have been geo-tagged on GIS and are being used for better planning 
and monitoring of projects. In PMGSY-III, National Rural Infrastructure Development Agency 
(NRIDA) has prepared a network planning algorithm called Trace Maps which simulates the 
traffic from habitations to nearby facilities to identify and calculate road usage in rural areas. 
This information is then used to suggest important routes and major rural links to field engineers 
to help them with planning. Further, road proposals proposed by states are also scrutinized on a 
sample basis on GIS along with satellite imagery and other informative layers to see if the roads 
are meeting PMGSY- III objectives. NRIDA has prepared a Web GIS tool called GeoSADAK 
which allows for NRIDA, State Rural Road Development Agency (SRRDA) and PIUs to make 
use of GIS without needing specialized GIS expertise. Programme Implementation Unit can 
draw the proposals on the tool under their login and SRRDA and NRIDA can verify the 
alignments before sanction.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 3955 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 06.04.2022 
 
TIME-BOUND COMPLETION OF DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMMES IN RURAL 
AREAS 
 
3955  SHRI SUSHIL KUMAR GUPTA:  
 
Will the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether is is a fact that the Hon'ble Prime Minister has emphasised the need for time 
bound
 completion of development programmes in rural areas; 
(b)  if so, the measures taken for speedier completion of development programmes in the 
last two years; and 
(c)  the new technologies adopted for faster completion of projects without compromising 
the quality? 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT 
(SADHVI NIRANJAN JYOTI) 
 
(a) & (b): Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) lays emphasis on targeted implementation 
and time-bound completion of programmes/projects under various schemes. In order to ensure 
that the schemes reach closure, the Ministry has evolved a comprehensive multi-level and multi-
format system of monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of rural development 
schemes, including Performance Review Committee Meetings, District Development Co-
ordination and Monitoring Committee (“DISHA”) meetings, National Level Monitors (NLMs), 
Area Officers Schemes, Common Review Mission, Concurrent Evaluation and Impact 
Assessment Studies. Further, the schemes of the MoRD have been brought under end- to-end 
transaction based MIS, which enables all the stakeholders to monitor status of schemes in a real 
time basis. The works are photographed with geo-tags and time stamps. 
  
  
In addition to the above, the Ministry arranges for sufficient funds and forest clearances that 
require facilitation with other Ministries/ Departments in a timely manner for completion of 
works. Social Audits are also conducted for schemes like Mahatma Gandhi National Rural 
Employment Guarantee Scheme (Mahatma Gandhi NREGS) and Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-
Gramin (PMAY-G) and appointment of Ombudsmen are made for attending to any grievances 
regarding Mahatma Gandhi NREGS works. 
 
 
(c):  The Ministry has adopted a number of technologies, ICT solutions including mobile apps, 
as well as guidelines for better implementation of the rural development for online monitoring of 
physical and financial progress, including: 
 
 
(i) Under Mahatma Gandhi NREGS, Software for Estimate Calculation using rural Rates for 
Employment (SECURE) has been developed for work estimation and Technical/ Administrative 
(Financial) approvals of works created under the scheme through NREGASoft. 
343

  
 
(ii) In order to promote cost-effective and fast construction technologies in the construction of 
rural roads using new materials/waste materials/locally available materials, „Guidelines on 
Technology Initiatives‟ have been issued under Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY). 
Some of the important technologies used in PMGSY are Cell filled Concrete, Panelled Cement 
Concrete, Roller Compacted Concrete Pavement, Cement Stabilization, Terrazyme, Cold Mix 
Technology, use of Waste Plastic, Surface dressing and Full-Depth Reclamation (FDR).  
 
 
(iii) Under PMAY-G, beneficiaries are being assisted in house construction through PAHAL 
compendium with a bouquet of house design typologies inclusive of disaster resilient features 
that are suitable to their local geo-climatic conditions. For the quality construction of the houses 
in a time bound manner, the States/UTs have been asked to ensure the sustained availability of 
good quality construction materials. A dash board has been developed enabling micromonitoring 
of implementation issues at different levels.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT 
DEPARTMENT OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT 
 
RAJYA  SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 3957 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 06.04.2022 
 
IMPLEMENTATION OF SGSY 
 
3957  SHRI K.R.N. RAJESHKUMAR: 
 
Will the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether Government has made any assessment study regarding implementation of 
Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY); 
(b)  if so, the outcome of the assessment studies and the reaction of Government thereto; 
(c)  whether the f indings of these assessment studies are far from reality; and 
(d)  if so, the reaction of Government thereto? 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF 
STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT 
(SADHVI NIRANJAN JYOTI) 
 
(a) & (b) The Ministry of Rural Development set up Radhakrishna Committee in April, 2008 to 
examine the credit related issues under Swarna Jayanti Gram Swarojgar Yojana (SGSY) and bring 
out the deficiencies in the delivery system. 
 
 
Some of the major findings of the Committee regarding SGSY are as follows:   
i. Delay in sanctioning of loans, non-cooperation of the Banks and lack of proper guidance were 
creating problems. 
ii. There was lack of coordination between Bank Branches and Block officials. 
iii. No effective monitoring was being made after sanctioning loans. 
iv. The overall credit achievement under SGSY was very low and there were persistent gaps 
between credit targets set and the actual mobilization of credit. 
v. The financial services did not have the systems and procedures suited to the poor. 
vi. The credit flow was severely handicapped due to the low number of Bank Branches and 
manpower.  
(c) & (d) The findings of the evaluation were accepted and based on the recommendations of the 
Radhakrishna Committee, Swarna Jayanti Gram Swarojgar Yojana (SGSY) was restructured into 
Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) and it was 
launched on 03 rd June, 2011. After a transition period of two years, SGSY has ceased to exist with 
effect from 01 st April, 2013. The present programme aims at addressing all the gaps and 
shortcomings as pointed out by the Radhakrishna Committee. DAY-NRLM intend to build strong 
and sustainable grass roots institutions of rural poor women and to enable them to access resources, 
knowledge for gainful self-employment, skilled wage employment opportunities and thereby 
achieving appreciable improvement in their incomes on a sustainable basis. As on 28 th February, 
2022 under DAY-NRLM 8.16 Crore Households have been mobilized into 74.80 lakh Self Help 
Groups and a total of Rs. 17,342 crore of Capitalisation Support has been provided to SHGs and 
their federations towards extending the credit to SHG members.

(b)  the number of women SHGs under NRLM in May 2014, State- wise; 
(c)  the number of women SHGs at present, State- wise; 
(d)  the number of SHGs targeted and created under NRLM in the last three years, yearwise; 
(e)  the benefits extended to women SHGs under NRLM; 
(f)  the funds directly released by Ministry under interest subvention benefit, State-wise; and 
(g)  the funds released to State Governments for interest subvention benefits, State-wise 
and year-wise during the last three years?

(a)  The total bank credit availed by Women Self Help Groups (SHGs) under Deendayal

(e)  Under DAY - NRLM programme, there is provision of providing Community Investment 
Support Fund (CISF) in the form of Revolving Funds (RF) at the rate of Rs.10,000-15,000 per 
SHG and Community Investment Fund (CIF) to the extent of Rs. 2,50,000 per SHG to Self Help 
Groups (SHGs) and their federations to take up self-employment for income generation and 
livelihoods activities. Apart from this, DAY-NRLM also facilitates credit mobilisation for SHGs 
in the form of bank loans. In order to reduce the effective cost of bank credit to women SHGs, 
DAY-NRLM is providing interest subvention to SHGs on loans from banks from Financial Year

COMPETITIONS AND AWARDS OF THE MINISTRY 
 
3959 DR. VINAY P. SAHASRABUDDHE: 
 
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be pleased to 
state: 
 
(a)  what are the various competitions organised and awards given by the Ministry and its 
Departments, the details thereof; 
 
(b)  what is the competition-wise number of participants from each State in last two years, 
the details thereof; and 
 
(c)  whether there are any awardees from the North-Eastern States for the awards given by the 
Ministry and its Departments in last three years, the details thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF 
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
 
(a) The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) has organised the following 
competitions and awards during the period 2020-21 and 2021-22: 
 
i. India Skills Competition: IndiaSkills Competition is a biennial event in skill competition involving 
participation from all over the India. IndiaSkills 2021, National competition was held from 06 th to 10 th 
January, 2022 in which participants from 26 States/Union Territories (UTs) displayed their talents in 
54 Skills such as beauty therapy, cyber Security, Floor tiling, Robotics system, Cloud Computing, 
Water Technology, painting and decorating, health and social care etc.  
 
ii. Awards for Excellence in District Skill Development Planning (DSDP):  DSDP Award instituted 
by MSDE in 2018 seeks to recognise the excellence in creating the most functional and innovative 
DSDP – the district’s plan of action for skilling, matching the demand of skills individuals through 
targeted supply side intervention, emphasise on inclusion of women and other marginalized groups. 
All districts of India are eligible to participate in the award. In the DSDP Awards,awards are given to 
the districts based on the evaluation of their skill development plansand presentations by the 
shortlisted districts. No competition is held for the purpose.  
 
iii. Kaushalacharya Awards: MSDE has been implementing Kaushalacharya Awards from 2019 with 
a view to motivating trainers to join the Skill India Mission. It is an annual event that focuses on 
honouring the skill trainers and the impact created by them on India’s youth. The awards are given in 
two categories viz Engineering trades and Non-Engineering trades. Each State sends prescribed 
nomination which are evaluated and the best of them are awarded by the Selection Committee 
constituted for the purpose. The last two Kaushalacharya awards were organised on 10.09.2020 and 
17.09.2021 respectively.  
 
(b) The State wise list of number of participants in the IndiaSkills 2021 is given at Annexure I.The 
State-wise list of number of participants (districts) in the period of 2020-21 under DSDP Awards is 
given at Annexure II. Further,92 trainers in the year 2020 and 41 trainers in the year 2021, from 
diverse backgrounds including experts of WorldSkills Competition winners, trainers from National Skill 
Training Institutes (NSTIs), Industrial Training Centres (ITI), Jan Sikshan Sansthans (JSS) and 
trainers from reputed Corporate houses such as companies namely Adobe, IBM, Microsoft, Maruti, 
ONGC, Bosch, Bhel and Aegis were awarded Kaushalacharya awards. 
 
(c) Under IndiaSkills 2021 Competition, 3 awards were given to the North East States which 
includes participants from Assam, Tripura and Mizoram.Under the DSDP Awards, 3 awards were 
given to North East states, which includes award given to Sonitpur and Maujli districts from Assam 
and Gomati district of Tripura. The Kaushalacharya Awards was given to 10 awardees of the North 
East States during the last three years.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 3960 
 TO BE ANSWERED ON 06.04.2022 
 
HELP TO ENTREPRENEURS 
 
3960.  DR. SASMIT PATRA: 
 
   Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be 
pleased to state: 
 
(a)  how many persons became entrepreneurs in the country over the last five years, 
year-wise and State-wise; 
 
(b)  how did Government help the development of such entrepreneurs ; 
 
(c)  how many of them are successful today ; and 
 
(d)  the success stories of these entrepreneurs, the details thereof? 
  
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF  
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
  
(a) The data of number of persons becoming entrepreneurs in the country is not 
maintained centrally. However, the Government has enacted many policies and schemes 
across various Ministries that encourage and boost Startups and Entrepreneurship. The 
details of beneficiaries under Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme (ESDP) 
scheme of Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Pradhan Mantri MUDRA 
Yojana (PMMY) and Stand Up India (SUPI) Scheme of the Ministry of Finance, 
Department of Financial Services, Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme (SVEP) 
of Ministry of Rural Development and Pilot Project on PM-YUVA of the Ministry of Skill 
Development and Entrepreneurship, are available at Annexure-I to Annexure-V  
respectively. 
 
(b) The details of various Schemes of the Government of India for development of 
Entrepreneurship in the Country are given below:- 
 
(i) Pilot Project on Entrepreneurship Development (PM YUVA) of the Ministry of Skill 
Development and Entrepreneurship was implemented with the objective for creating an 
enabling ecosystem through entrepreneurship education, training, advocacy and easy 
access to entrepreneurship network, for students and alumni of skill training institutes 
viz.  Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs), Polytechnics, Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra 
(PMKK) and Jan Shikshan Sansthan (JSS) in 10 States and 2 Union Territories. 
 
(ii)  The National Institute for Entrepreneurship and Small Business Development 
(NIESBUD), Noida and Indian Institute of Entrepreneurship (IIE), Guwahati are two 
autonomous organizations functioning under the administrative control of the Ministry of 
Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. The major activities of the Institutes include 
Training of Trainers, Management Development Programmes, Entrepreneurship-cum-Skill 
Development Programmes, Entrepreneurship Development Programmes and Cluster 
Intervention. IIE, Guwahati has focus especially on North Eastern Region. 
368

(iii)  The Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) of Department of Financial Services 
was launched by the Hon’ble Prime Minister on 08.04.2015 to extend collateral free loans 
up to Rs. 10 lakh through Member Lending Institutions (MLIs) to individuals to enable them 
to set up or expand their business activities. The scheme facilitates loans in three 
categories namely Shishu (upto Rs. 50,000), Kishore (Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 5 lakh) and Tarun 
(Rs. 5 lakh to Rs. 10 Lakh) for income generating activities in Manufacturing, Trading, 
Services Sector and also for the activities allied to agriculture. 
  
(iv) The Stand Up India Scheme of Department of Financial Services was launched by the 
Hon’ble Prime Minister on 5
th April, 2016 and has been extended upto the year 2025. The 
objective of the Stand Up India Scheme is to facilitates loans from Scheduled Commercial 
Banks (SCBs) of value between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 Crore to at least one Scheduled 
Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and one women borrower per bank branch 
for setting up a green field enterprise in manufacturing, services or trading sector and also 
for the activities allied to agriculture. 
  
(v) The objective of the Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme (ESDP) 
scheme is to motivate youth representing different sections of the society including 
SC/ST/Women, differently abled, Ex-servicemen and Below Poverty Line (BPL) persons to 
consider self employment or entrepreneurship as one of the career options. The ultimate 
objective is to promote new enterprises, capacity building of existing MSMEs and 
inculcating entrepreneurial culture in the Country.  
  
(vi) Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme (SVEP) of Ministry of Rural 
Development, is a sub-scheme under the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana–National Rural 
Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) with an objective to help the rural poor to set-up 
enterprises at the village level in non-agricultural sectors. Besides helping the rural 
entrepreneurs to access finance, a cadre of Community Resource Persons - Enterprise 
Promotion (CRP-EP) is also promoted to provide business support services to enterprises 
in rural areas. The Community Enterprise Fund (CEF) is a dedicated fund given on the 
lines of Community Investment Fund (CIF) provided under NRLM, for the blocks under 
SVEP to give loans to the entrepreneurs selected as per the guidelines and norms of 
SVEP. The CEF amount is 2.55 cr. for each SVEP block. It help to enhance credit 
worthiness of the village entrepreneurs and also showcase the ability of the community 
institution led enterprise capital provisions to demonstrate disciplined credit behavior. A 
total of 197,168 enterprises have been supported so far across the 23 States/UT under 
SVEP. 
  
(c) & (d) The success stories of entrepreneurs under PMMY and SUPI are available in 
public domain at https://www.mudra.org.in and https://www.standupmitra.in respectively.

SKILL CENTRES FOR HAWKERS IN ODISHA 
 
3961.  SMT. MAMATA MOHANTA:  
 
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be 
pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether any proposal has been submitted by States for skill development of street 
vendors under the Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) to help them in earning 
more revenue;
 
 
(b) if so, the details thereof ;  
 
(c) the details of employment opportunities created for hawkers in the country, 
including Odisha in this regard; 
 
(d) whether Government proposes to expand this programme for street vendors in 
Odisha; and 
 
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF  
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP
 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
 
(a) to (c)         Under PMKVY, more than 20 thousand street food vendors have been 
trained /oriented through Short -Term Training (STT) and Recognition of Prior Learning 
(RPL) in 18 States/UTs including State of Odisha. The State-wise details, as on 
31.12.2021, are given at Annexure. 
 
  
Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) has launched a pilot 
project for ‘ Upskilling for Street Food Vendors (for e-cart license)’ in East Delhi Municipal 
Corporation (EDMC) on 30.11.2021 to train over 2,500 street food vendors over a period 
of four months. The purpose of this skill development is to impart skills which would lead to 
better services to consumers, more opportunities to the vendors in revenue generation and 
awareness of regulations, and adherence to stipulated rules and better services for the 
local bodies. Candidates would be provided with the dual certification from the Tourism & 
Hospitality Skill Council, and the FSSAI. Despite disruption caused due to COVID-19 
pandemic, 686 street food vendors have been enrolled and out of which, 417 street food 
vendors have been oriented till date. 
  
(d) and (e)      The project of ‘ Upskilling for Street Food Vendors (for e-cart license)’ is a 
pilot for East Delhi Municipal Corporation (EDMC). Further, Ministry has no plan to extend 
this project presently in the State of Odisha.

state: 
 
(a)  the details of implementation of the Skill loan scheme at present;   
 
(b)  the steps taken, if any, to encourage individuals to make use of the scheme, details of 
the beneficiaries in different demographics, State-wise, with special reference to State of Karnataka;  
 
(c)  the details of funds allocated, sanctioned and disbursed in the last three years ;  
 
(d)  the details of steps taken to revamp the scheme to meet expected targets ; and  
 
(e)  details of steps taken to incentivise banks to enhance lending for skilling, relaxation in 
the loan eligibility criteria and the repayment conditions? 
 
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF 
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
 
(a) The Government of India had launched Skill Loan Scheme on 15
th July, 2015 to provide loan 
facility to aspirants wanting to do skill development courses aligned to National Skill Qualification 
Framework (NSQF). Any Indian National who has secured admission in a course run by Industrial 
Training Institutes (ITIs), Polytechnics or in a school recognised by Central or State education Boards 
or in a college affiliated to recognised university, training partners affiliated to National Skill 
Development Corporation (NSDC), Sector Skill Councils, State Skill Mission, State Skill Corporation, 
etc. can avail loan for the purpose. Amount of loan varies from Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 150, 000/- depending 
on the course and has a repayment period of 3 to 7 years. 
 
(b) The scheme inter-alia include the following provisions which in turn encourage individuals to 
make use of the scheme: 
 
I. No processing fee is charged by Banks/Microfinance Institutions (MFI).  
II. Simple rate of interest @ 11 % and 12 % per annum is charged during the period of study. 
III. No minimum restriction with regard to age. 
IV. The borrower can repay the loan any time after commencement of repayment without having 
to pay any prepayment charges. In case a student is not able to complete the course because 
of accident/death/disability the bank can seek a pro-rata reimbursement of the unfinished 
portion of the course amount from the training institute. This will reduce the loan burden on the 
students. 
V. The loan is sanctioned without any collateral security or third party guarantee.  
 
The State wise and Union Territory-wise list of beneficiaries including the State of Karnataka under 
the Skill Loan Scheme is placed at Annexure I. 
 
(c) The State-wise and Union Territory-wise details of amount sanctioned during the last three 
years under the scheme are given at Annexure II. 
 
(d) Presently, there is no proposal to revamp the scheme. 
 
(e) Under the Scheme, risk of banks covered through Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme for Skill 
Development (CGFSSD). Under the scheme of CGFSSD, interest rate to be charged by Member 
Lending Institution (MLI) should not be more than 1.5% per annum over Base Rate. 
Further, borrower must enter into an agreement with National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company 
(NCGTC) for providing guarantee against default in repayment of the loan extended by lending 
institutions. The fund shall provide guarantee cover to the extent of 75% of the amount in default. The 
above steps incentivise banks to enhance lending for skilling.

entrepreneurship which can generate wealth and employment so as to ensure sustainable 
livelihoods for all citizens in the country.

Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, are given below.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 3965

SKILLING YOUNG INDIANS 
 
3965. SHRI NARAINDASS GUPTA :  
 
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be 
pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether the target of skilling 3 crore young Indians by 2022 is on its course, the 
details thereof; 
 
(b) whether Government has the database to ascertain whether those who have 
been skilled are employed too; 
 
(c) how many of those trained have started their own business; 
 
(d) whether surveys to find out the exact skill requirements from the prospective 
employees have been conducted, the details thereof; and  
 
(e) what can be done to bridge the skill gaps and enhance employability of youths? 
 
 
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF 
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR)  
 
(a) Yes. Sir, Government has already achieved this target. Under Skill India Mission, 
more than 20 Central Ministries/Departments are implementing various Skill 
Development Schemes/Programmes to enhance skill levels of millions of people on pan 
India basis through which more than 570 lakh persons have been trained since 2015.  
 
(b) Yes Sir.  
 
1. PMKVY: A three-month placement / self-employment monitoring is done 
by Training Providers, DSCs, SSDMs. 
 
2. Under other schemes of MSDE, tracking of placement records is not 
mandatory and hence records of the same are not maintained.  
(c) In order to inculcate entrepreneurship skills in the candidates for establishing 
business, the PMKVY scheme has a mandatory provision for training of an English, 
Employability & Entrepreneurship (EEE) module, besides the core curriculum of the 
course. Further, Training Providers provide support to the candidates for 
entrepreneurship development by facilitating bank linkages along with providing 
guidance and mentoring support. As on 31.12.2021, around 2.95 lakh candidates have 
been self-employed across the country. 
 
 
386

(d)&(e) Yes Sir. The Government had engaged various organizations including 
Accenture, KPMG, and PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) through the National Skill 
Development Corporation (NSDC) for conducting district-level skill gap studies for 
different states in India. The studies were conducted in 443 districts. They contain 
information on district-wise skill gaps over 2012-17 and 2017-22. The overall objective 
of the State-wise studies was to assess the district-level skill gaps in the concerned 
States, both in terms of numbers and the required skills and competence. The studies 
provide information on the skills needed and the skill gaps in various sectors across 
districts in the state. They help understand the skill requirements and opportunities 
within the states. Further, Human Resource and Skill Requirement Study for 21 Coastal 
Districts of India were prepared for: Sagarmala, Ministry of Shipping. 
Further, District Skill Committees (DSCs), under the guidance of respective State 
Skill Development Missions (SSDMs), are playing a key role in addressing the skill gap 
and assessing demand at the district level including in rural areas. The DSCs have 
been entrusted with the development of District Skill Development Plans (DSDPs) to 
promote decentralized planning and implementation at the grassroots. To build capacity 
of the DSCs and to help them manage skill development planning and program delivery, 
the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) attaches Mahatma 
Gandhi National Fellows with the district administration. The Fellows are posted as part 
of their academic programme in premier management institutes, which has an in-built 
component of on-ground practical experience. So far, more than 510 DSDPs have been 
received from 31 States/ Union Territories. The DSDPs identify sectors in which 
employment opportunities and demand for skilling exists. These activities are performed 
under the World Bank assisted programme Skill Acquisition and Knowledge Awareness 
for Livelihood Promotion (SANKALP) for strengthening of skilling institutions. 
 All our skill programmes continue to incorporate such information and introduce 
skilling programmes as required to augment employability of the youth.

CRAFTSMEN TRAINING SCHEME 
3966. SHRI DEREK O’BRIEN: 
 Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be 
pleased to state: 
a) the budget allocation for the Craftsmen Training Scheme since its inception and the 
current FY 22-23, year-wise, details thereof; 
b) how many craftsmen have benefitted so far?details thereof;and 
c) whether Government has launched or plans to launch any women specific training 
schemes regarding art and handicrafts, if so, the budget allocation for the same, the details 
thereof? 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF  
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
a) Craftsmen Training Scheme is for providing long-term training in 143 trades through 
Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) across the country. There are 33 National Skill Training 
Institutes across the country which also impart courses under Craftsmen Training 
Scheme.Setting up of ITIs and its operation are in the domain of respective State 
Governments, whereas preparation of norms and designing curricula along with conducting 
examination and certification are the responsibility of Central Government. Hence, there is 
no provision for allocation of funds under Craftsmen Training Scheme.   
b) The detail of ITIs functioning across the country along with the Number of Trainees 
enrolled under Craftsmen Training Scheme (CTS) is given in Annexure – I. The detail of 
NSTIs functioning across the country along with the Number of Trainees enrolled under 
Craftsmen Training Scheme is given in Annexure-II. 
c) While there are no women specific schemes for training schemes regarding arts and 
crafts in Industrial Training Institutes, Government has made a provision of 30% reservation 
of seats for women candidates all over the country in Industrial Training Institutes. The 
Government has in place the policy to develop the teaching process in the way of training of 
trainer’s development programme and conducts the programme through 19 National Skill 
Training Institutes which are exclusively for women in 15 states/UTs of India. 
Under Skill India Mission, more than 20 central Ministries/Departments are running 
schemes/programs to impart skill training to the youth including women. Ministry of Skill 
Development and Entrepreneurship is implementing a flagship scheme Pradhan Mantri 
Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) to impart short duration skill development training to youth 
including women of the country. Under PMKVY, training has been imparted in various job 
roles of 37 different sectors including job roles of traditional arts and crafts under Handicrafts 
and Carpet Sector Skill Council (HCSSC).  
 
Under PMKVY, as on 31.12.2021 since 2016, 2,62,880 candidates have been 
trained/oriented (20,196 trained under STT and 2,42,684 oriented under RPL) in various 
traditional job roles in the country. Out of the total 2,62,880 trained candidates, 1,72,105 
388

candidates are females while 90,547 candidates are males. Some of the traditional job roles 
are Bamboo Basket Maker, Bamboo Mat Weaver, Beading Artisans, Carpet Weaving, 
Carving Artisans, Tarakashi Jeweller, Decorative Painter, Sketching & Painting Artisans, 
Hand Rolled Agarbatti Maker, Crochet Lace Trailers, Hand Embroiderer etc.  
 
Ministry through NSDC is implementing several special projects under PMKVY 
targeting artisans’ clusters in partnership with private sector in a manner where 100% 
artisans are ensured employment. Under this, special project to revive the traditional Namda 
craft of Jammu & Kashmir and Upskilling of Weavers & Artisans on traditional crafts of 
Nagaland and Jammu and Kashmir are being implemented. 
 
The Scheme of Jan Shikshan Sansthan(JSS) for Skill Development is a Central 
Sector Scheme. JSSs are imparting skill training to non-literate, nonliterates, persons. Under 
JSS, as on 01.04.2022 since 2017, 15,68,619 candidates have been trainedout of which 
women  percentage is 85%.

(c)        The objective of the ESDP scheme of the Ministry of MSME is to motivate 
youth representing different sections of the society including SC/ST/Women, differently 
abled, Ex-servicemen and Below Poverty Line (BPL) persons to consider self 
employment or entrepreneurship as one of the career options. The ultimate objective 
is to promote new enterprises, capacity building of existing MSMEs and inculcating 
entrepreneurial culture in the Country.
 
  
‘Economic Empowerment of Women Entrepreneurs and Start-ups by Women’ 
(WEE) project is being supported by  Deutsche Gesellschaft fuer Internationale 
Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH, on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic 
Cooperation and Development (BMZ), in partnership with MSDE,  to improve the 
framework conditions for women-led enterprises in India. The project aims to pilot 
incubation and acceleration programmes for women micro entrepreneurs, enabling 
them to start new businesses and scale up existing enterprises in the States of 
Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Telangana, Uttar Pradesh and 8 North Eastern States of the 
Country.  A total of 725 women entrepreneurs have been supported under the project 
under both incubation and acceleration support programmes.

(c) to (d) :   Police and Public Order are state subjects under the Seventh Schedule to the

INFORMATION ABOUT SAKHI-ONE-STOP CENTRES 
  
3985.   PROF. MANOJ KUMAR JHA: 
  
   Will the Minister of Women and Child Development be pleased to state:  
  
(a)   the number of functional Sakhi-One-Stop Centres (OSCs) in the country, 
State-wise and UT-wise; 
 
(b)   the number of psychologists/ counsellors available at these centres, State-
wise and UT-wise; 
 (c)   the steps taken by the Centre and the State Governments towards 
increasing Sexual and Gender Based Violence (SGBV) survivors’ direct 
access to OSC for medical services, without going through the police; and 
 (d)   the details of the training given to OSC staff on medical confidentiality and 
psychological first aid in the last two years, State-wise and UT-wise? 
  
  
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
  
  
(a) to (d):   The Government of India implements the One Stop Centre (OSC) 
Scheme with effect from 1st April, 2015. OSCs provide a range of integrated 
services under one roof including  police facilitation, medical aid, legal aid and 
counselling, psycho-social counselling  and temporary shelter  to 
women   aﬀected  by violence or in distress.   As on date, 733 OSCs have been 
approved for 729 districts across the country,   out of which 704 OSCs have been 
operationalized in 35 States/ UTs, which have assisted over 4.93 lakh women. The 
setting up of OSCs from the year 2015 onward, at district level, have provided a 
dedicated platform to women facing violence and who are in distress to get 
necessary help and assistance, which was not available earlier.  
  
Since the State / District Authorities are responsible for recruitment and appointment 
of suitable manpower / staff at these centres for effective implementation of the 
scheme, the details of the number of psychologists/ counsellors  is not maintained 
centrally. However,  as per information received from 24 States/ UTs, 520 
counsellors have been appointed. The State/ UT –wise details of functional OSCs 
and the number of psycho-social counsellors is at Annexure. 
  
440

The Ministry also reviews implementation of the scheme and functioning of these 
centres from time to time through meetings, Video Conferencing and by issuing 
advisories to States Governments/ UT Administrations..  
  
The Central Government gives high priority to ensuring safety and security of women 
and has undertaken various steps for helping the victims of sexual and gender based 
violence and supports and supplements the efforts of States / UTs in ensuring the 
safety and security of women and girls including the cases of sexual and gender 
based violence.  The schemes/ projects include One Stop Centres (OSCs); 
Universalisation of Women Helplines (WHL), Emergency Response Support System 
(ERSS) which is a pan-India single number (112)/ mobile app based system for 
emergencies; a cyber-crime reporting portal to report obscene content; safe city 
projects in 8 cities (Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Kolkata, 
Lucknow and Mumbai) including infrastructure, technology adoption and capacity 
building in community through awareness programmes, training and skill 
development programs for Investigation Officers, Prosecution Officers and Medical 
Officers; distribution of Sexual Assault Evidence Collection (SAEC) Kits to States/ 
UTs; establishment of state of the art DNA Laboratory at CFSL, Chandigarh; 
assistance to 24 States/ UTs to strengthen Forensic Science Laboratories; setting up 
of 1023 Fast Track Special Courts (FTSCs) for speedy disposal of cases of rape and 
cases under POCSO Act; setting up/ strengthening of Anti Human Trafficking Units 
(AHTUs) in all districts of the country; setting up/ strengthening of Women Help 
Desks (WHDs) at Police Stations etc.  
  
Under Nirbhaya Fund, Bureau of Police Research and Development (BPR&D) has 
also undertaken several initiatives, which, inter-alia includes training and skill 
development programs for Investigation Officers, Prosecution Officers and Medical 
Officers, distribution of Sexual Assault Evidence Collection (SAEC) Kits to States/ 
UTs.  BPR&D has also prepared Standard Operating Procedures (SoPs) for ‘Women 
Help Desk at Police Stations’ to ensure smooth functioning of Women Help Desks by 
focusing on four critical components viz. infrastructure, training, human resource 
development and response mechanism.  A book titled ‘Women’s Safety and 
Security- a Handbook for Fi rst Responders and Investigators in the Police’ has also 
been prepared for the purpose of prevention and investigation of crime against 
women with specific reference to the crime of sexual assault, which includes 
investigation, victim compensation and rehabilitation.  Emphasis has been laid upon 
appropriate behavioural and attitudinal skills of the police in course of prevention and 
detection of crime against women and children and interaction with victims of 
crime.  Webinars on women safety with sensitivity, gender sensitization of police 
personnel etc. have also been organized by BPR&D.    
  
Ministry of Women and Child Development has engaged the services of National 
Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences (NIMHANS) for providing  basic and 
advanced training under the project named ‘Stree Manoraksha’ to the staff of One 
Stop Centres (OSCs) across the country on  handling psycho-social and mental 
health care needs to support the women facing violence and women in distress.

3987  DR. KANIMOZHI NVN SOMU: 
 
Will the Minister of Women and child Development be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  the total number of Swadhar Grehs currently operational/set up in the country, 
State/UT-wise, including Tamil Nadu; 
(b)  whether Government has reviewed the implementation of Swadhar Greh scheme and 
if so, the details thereof; 
(c)  the details of the monitoring mechanism in place to ensure the effective 
implementation of the scheme and the assessment made during the last three years; 
and 
(d)  the steps taken to popularize the address and contact details of these Swadhar

MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT

(a) The total number of Swadhar Grehs currently operational in the country is 357. State/UT-
wise details, including Tamil Nadu, is at Annexure-I. 
 
(b) Swadhar Greh Scheme has been evaluated by the NITI Aayog. The major 
recommendations of this evaluation inter-alia include integration of Swadhar Greh and 
Ujjawala Homes, revision of the salary norms of the staff and use of information technology 
tools in the implementation of the Scheme. This scheme is now part of the new Mission 
Shakti which has life cycle continuum approach to women related issues. The 
recommendations have been duly incorporated in Mission Shakti.  
 
(c) The Swadhar Greh scheme envisages monitoring of its implementation at District, State 
and Central level. Swadhar Grehs are monitored continuously by a District Monitoring 
Committee where at least two members are women and the district committee meets at least 
once in a quarter. Monitoring Committee at State level meets at least twice a year and 
monitors the projects. Continuation of grant to any agency depends on the satisfactory 
performance as assessed by the State/UT level Committee. Ministry of Women and Child 
Development also reviews the functioning of the Swadhar Greh at regular intervals with the 
State Governments/UT administrations. 
 
(d) As per the Scheme Guidelines, the implementing agency is required to display the name, 
telephone numbers and address of the Swadhar Greh in capital letters in local language 
along with the name and telephone numbers of District level officers concerned and the 
facilities available in the Swadhar Greh at a prominent place in the Swadhar Greh. Under the 
new Mission Shakti, it is envisaged to revise the Scheme guidelines to make them more 
useful for the beneficiaries and spread awareness about these homes through the National 
Hub for Empowerment of Women.

(a) The State/ UT-wise and year-wise details of funds released and utilized for the

(b) and (c)    Out of Rs. 6212.85 crore (including Rs.500 crore allocated to the Ministry 
of Women and Child Development in the financial year 2021-22) allocated under 
Nirbhaya Fund, an amount of Rs. 4366.89 crore  has been disbursed/ released by the 
concerned Ministries/ Departments for implementation of various projects/ schemes.  
  
The projects/ schemes under Nirbhaya Fund are demand driven. The projects/ 
schemes appraised by Empowered Committee (EC) under the Framework for Nirbhaya 
Fund are having staggered implementation schedule. Further, some of the appraised 
projects are directly implemented by Central Ministries/ Departments. However, majority 
of the projects are implemented through State Governments/ Union Territory 
Administrations in which Central Government releases the funds to States/ UTs as per 
prescribed fund sharing pattern of respective projects/ schemes. Implementation on the 
447

ground is done by the States/ UTs as per the approved implementation period. There 
are schemes, which require recurring expenditure for providing services, in respect of 
which, further funds are released upon receipt of Utilisation Certificates (UCs) and 
Statement of Expenditure (SoE) from the Implementing Agency/ authority. The UCs are 
required to be submitted within twelve months of the closure of financial year, in which 
grant was released. Hence, it is possible that more funds have been actually utilised, 
but Utilisation Certificates (UCs) and Statement of Expenditure (SoE), as required as 
per provisions of General Financial Rules (GFR) have not been submitted by the 
concerned States/ Implementing Agencies (IAs). The States/ IAs are regularly followed 
up to submit UCs and SoEs. Various other factors such as time taken in getting 
required approvals from competent authorities, procedure to be followed for award of 
contract, disruptions due to unforeseen reasons such as the one created by the Covid 
19, etc., also affect implementation of schemes/ projects.   
  
(d)    An amount of Rs.26.54 crore and Rs. 28.31 crore have been disbursed/ released 
to the States of Odisha and Bihar respectively, under Nirbhaya Fund for establishment 
and management of One Stop Centers in the States.

Nirbhaya Fund appraises and recommends proposals for funding out of Nirbhaya Fund. 
The EC also reviews the status of implementation of schemes/ projects under Nirbhaya 
Fund, from time to time, in conjunction with the concerned Ministries/ Departments/ 
Implementing Agencies. Further, monitoring and reviewing is also done at the level of 
State Governments/ UT Administrations / Implementing Agencies in the course of 
implementation.

Mission Poshan 2.0, an integrated nutrition support programme has been announced in 
budget 2021-2022 for all States/UTs. Moreover, steps have been taken to improve 
nutritional quality and testing in accredited labs, strengthen delivery and leverage 
technology under Poshan Tracker to improve governance. States/UTs have been 
advised to promote use of AYUSH systems for prevention of malnutrition and related 
diseases. A programme to support development of Poshan Vatikas at Anganwadi 
Centres to meet dietary diversity gap leveraging traditional knowledge in nutritional 
practices has also been taken up. Guidelines were issued for transparency and 
accountability in delivery of supplementary nutrition and to track nutritional outcomes on 
13.01.2021. 
 
(e) Mission POSHAN 2.0 is an Integrated Nutrition Support Programme. It seeks to 
address the challenges of malnutrition in children, adolescent girls, pregnant women 
and lactating mothers through a strategic shift in nutrition content and delivery and by 
creation of a convergent eco-system to develop and promote practices that nurture 
health, wellness and immunity. Poshan 2.0 will seek to optimize the quality and delivery 
of food under the Supplementary Nutrition Program. Poshan 2.0 shall focus on Maternal 
Nutrition, Infant and Young Child Feeding Norms , Treatment of 
MAM/SAM and Wellness through  AYUSH. It will rest on the pillars of Convergence, 
Governance, and Capacity-building. Poshan Abhiyan will be the key pillar for Outreach 
and will cover innovations related to nutritional support, ICT interventions, Media 
Advocacy and Research, Community Outreach and Jan Andolan.

GROWING MALNUTRITION AMONG WOMEN AND CHILDREN DURING CORONA PANDEMIC  
  
3995. SHRI REWATI RAMAN SINGH: 
 
Will the minister of women and child Development be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether it is a fact that measures taken by Government to deal with the growing 
malnutrition among women and children in many parts of the country due to the corona 
virus pandemic during the year 2021- 2022 have not been sufficient; 
(b) whether Government proposes to co-ordinate with various States in the country for 
constant monitoring of the outcome related to nutrition of women and children; and  
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons therefore?  
 
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
  
(a) to (c) The Government has accorded high priority to the issue of malnutrition and is making 
serious efforts to address this issue. Government implements Anganwadi Services scheme, 
POSHAN Abhiyaan, Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana and scheme for Adolescent Girls 
under the Umbrella lntegrated Child Development Services Scheme (lCDS) as targeted 
interventions for children under 6 years, pregnant women and Lactating Mothers and Adolescent 
Girls, throughout the country. Further, Mission Poshan 2.0, an integrated nutrition support 
programme has been announced in budget 2021-2022 for all States/UTs. lt seeks to strengthen 
nutritional content, delivery, outreach and outcomes with focus on developing practices that nurture 
health, wellness and immunity to disease and malnutrition. All these schemes address in one or 
other aspects related to nutrition and have the potential to improve nutritional outcomes in the 
country. 
 
During COVID 19, in order to ensure continuous nutritional support to beneficiaries including 
children, Anganwadi Workers and Helpers distributed Supplementary Nutrition at the doorsteps of 
beneficiaries once in 15 days during the Covid-19 pandemic period. To limit the impact of the 
pandemic, all Anganwadi Centres across the country were closed.Further,  Poshan Pakhwada and 
POSHAN Maah were conducted during last 3 years, including during the pandemic in hybrid mode. 
Around 20.32 crore activities were conducted during POSHAN Maah 2021. These included both 
physical and online activities. Online activities included Webinars, Interactive sessions, Quizzes for 
children etc.  
  
In order to constantly monitor the outcome related to nutrition of women and children, the 
Government launched the Poshan Tracker management application which provides a 360-degree 
view of the activities of the Anganwadi Centre (AWC), service deliveries of Anganwadi Workers 
(AWWs) and complete beneficiary management for pregnant women, lactating mothers and 
children. Simultaneously, the mobile application also digitizes and automates physical registers 
used by AWWs that helps improving their quality of work.

(a) whether Government has conducted any survey to determine the impact of

(b) the implementation and targets achieved so far under POSHAN Abhiyaan in 
last three years, State-wise and expenditure-wise as well?

MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
  
(a)       Government has been receiving regular reports from the States on the 
prevailing scenario and activities undertaken during COVID-19 pandemic, though no 
formal survey on impact of COVID-19 on malnutrition has been conducted.  
  
(b)       Poshan Abhiyan was launched on 8th March 2018. The progress made and 
achievements under POSHAN Abhiyaan, so far, are as follows: 
 
i. Under POSHAN Abhiyaan, all the districts of 36 States/UTs have been covered 
for roll-out. 
ii
. State, District and Block level Convergence meetings are held regularly in most 
of the States/UTs. 
iii. Procurement of Smart phones and Growth Monitoring Devices has been 
coordinated through Government e-Marketplace (GeM) Portal. States/UTs are 
at various stages of procurement of Smart phones and GMDs. Till date, 11.03 
lakh Smart Phones and 11.94 lakh GMDs have been procured by the 
States/UTs. 
iv. A robust ICT Application “Poshan Tracker” has been conceptualised  which is 
an overarching system, providing facilities, services and inter-linkages, and 
thereby also promote real time data with analytics. Around 12.63 lakh AWCs 
have started using the ICT Application. 
v. Approx. 40+ crore Jan Andolan based activities have been conducted since the 
launch of the Abhiyaan.  
vi. Total three (4) Poshan Pakhwadas and four (4) Poshan Maahs have been 
conducted since the launch of the Abhiyaan. September, 2021 was celebrated 
466

as the Rashtriya Poshan Maah, wherein, 20.32 crore activities were conducted 
across the country. 
vii. 26 States/UTs have started implementing more than 50 Innovative projects, 
whereas 30 States/UTs have initiated implementation of Flexi Fund based 
activities. 
viii. More than 10 lakh Frontline Functionaries have been trained on thematic 
modules following the cascade mode of training at State, District and Block 
level.  
ix. Community Based Events (CBEs) are organized in a converged manner in 
Anganwadi Centres with the field functionaries. Around 3.70 crore CBEs have 
been organized since the launch of the Abhiyaan. 
  
POSHAN Abhiyaan aims to reduce malnutrition in the country in a phased 
manner, through a lifecycle approach, by adopting a synergised and result oriented 
approach. The targets laid down under the Abhiyaan are as under: 
 
S.No Objective Target 
1. Prevent and reduce Stunting in children (0- 6 years) @ 2% p.a. 
2. Prevent and reduce under-nutrition (underweight 
prevalence) in children (0-6 years) @ 2% p.a. 
3. Reduce the prevalence of anaemia among young 
Children(6-59 months) @ 3% p.a. 
4. Reduce the prevalence of anaemia among Women and 
Adolescent Girls in the age group of 15-49 years. @ 3% p.a. 
5. Reduce Low Birth Weight (LBW). @ 2% p.a. 
  
The estimated number of underweight, malnourished and severely 
malnourished children under 5 years of age is obtained under National Family Health 
Survey (NFHS) conducted by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. As per the 
recent report of NFHS-5 (2019-21), the nutrition indicators for children under 5 years 
have improved as compared with NFHS-4 (2015-16). Stunting has reduced from 
38.4% to 35.5%, Wasting has reduced from 21.0% to 19.3% and Underweight 
prevalence has reduced from 35.8% to 32.1%.

CHILDREN DEPRIVED OF DAILY NUTRITIONAL DIET  
  
4000. SH. K.R.N. RAJESH KUMAR 
  
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state? 
  
(a)  Whether children remain deprived of their daily nutritional diet in various parts of the 
country; 
(b)  If so, the details thereof, State/UT-wise including Tamil Nadu; 
(c)  Whether measures are being undertaken by the Government to raise awareness 
regarding availability of nutrition diet; and 
(d)  if so, the details thereof?

MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
  
 (a) & (b) Age specific Supplementary Nutrition is provided to children at anganwadi centres in 
all States/UTs including in Tamil Nadu as per nutritional norms laid down under National Food 
Security Act,2013.  
 
(c) & (d)  The Government is implementing several schemes and programs under the 
Umbrella Integrated Child Development Services Scheme as direct targeted interventions to 
address the problem of malnutrition in the country. All these schemes address one or other 
aspects related to nutrition and have the potential to improve nutritional outcomes in the 
country. For alleviation of malnutrition, Government has announced Mission Poshan 2.0 to 
strengthen nutritional content, delivery, outreach and outcomes with focus on developing 
practices that nurture health, wellness and immunity to disease and malnutrition. Steps have 
been taken to improve nutritional quality and testing in accredited labs, strengthen delivery 
and leverage technology to improve governance. Government has advised States/UTs to 
ensure that the quality of supplementary nutrition conforms to prescribed standards laid down 
under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and regulations made there under. 
States/UTs have been advised to promote use of AYUSH systems for prevention of 
malnutrition and related diseases. Streamlining Guidelines on Quality Assurance, Roles and 
responsibilities of duty holders, procedure for procurement, integrating Ayush concepts and 
Data Management and MOnitoring through 'Poshan tracker' for transparency, efficiency and 
accountibility in delivery of Supplementary Nutrition has also been issued on 13th January 
2021. A programme to support development of Poshan Vatikas at Anganwadi centres to meet 
dietary diversity gap leveraging traditional knowledge in nutritional practices has also been 
taken up. 
 
For creating awareness on nutrition and healthy diets, focus on behavioral change 
through community based events and Jan Andolan has been an important component under 
Poshan Abhiyaan. ln order to strengthen the processes for community engagement, 
empowerment of beneficiaries and increased social accountability, provisions are made for 
organizing community based events (CBEs)  by each Anganwadi Centre. Further, four Poshan 
Maahs and four Poshan Pakhwadas have been held since the launch of the Abhiyan, 
witnessing more than 40 crore activities of community participation and mobilisation.

संघ राज् यक्षेत्र जम्मू-कश्मीर की सरकार से प्राप्त जानकारी क े  अनुसार , जम्मू-कश्मीर 
संघ राज् यक्षेत्र में प्रिासी आबादी का एक बडा कहस्सा है जो गमी क े  मौसम की िुरुआत में 
अशधकतम छह महीने की अिशध , जो आमतौर पर अप्रैल/मई से िुरू और शसतंबर/अक्र्ूबर 
में समाप्त होती है, में अपने स्कूल जाने िाले बच्चों क े  सार् श्चजले क े  भीतर या एक क्षेत्र से 
दूसरे क्षेत्र में पिटत शिखर/चारागाह की ओर पलायन करते  हैं। जम्मू-कश्मीर संघ राज् यक्षेत्र 
घुमन् तु आबादी क े  इन बच्चों की शिक्षा सुविधा क े  शलए श्चजलों को सीजनल क ें द्र स्र्ावपत 
करने में सुविधा प्रदान करता है, जहां ये समुदाय 6 महीने तक रहते हैं।  
इन घुमंतू बच्चों को हर साल 06 महीने की प्रिास अिशध क े  दौरान शिक्षा प्रदान 
करने क े  शलए इन सीजनल क ें द्रों में सीजनल िैश्चक्षक स्ियंसेिक (एसईिी) रखे जाते हैं। इन 
सीजनल िैश्चक्षक स्ियंसेिकों की शनयुवि वििुद्ध रूप से अस्र्ायी होती है और जब ग्रीष्म 
मौसम समाप्त होने क े  बाद प्रिासी आबादी अपने मूल स्र्ानों पर िापस चली जाती है तो 
सीजनल क ें द्र को बंद कर कदया जाता है। सीजनल सेंर्र  से अपने-अपने घरों को लौर्ने क े  
बाद ये बच्चे अपने-अपने क्षेत्र क े  संबंशधत स्कूलों में पढाई जारी रखते हैं।

की अिशध क े  शलए शनयुि ककए जाने पर  उन् हें कम से कम 5 साल पूरे होने तक या किर

महामारी के  दौरान , शिक्षा मंत्रालय ने, शिक्षा तक  शनरंतर  पहुंच प्रदान करने के  शलए कई  कदम  उठाए हैं, 
जो छात्रों की  प्रत्येक श्रेर्ी के  शलए उनक े क्षेत्र या आशथधक मानक  के  बािजूद उपलब्ध हैं। पीएम ई-विद्या नामक 
एक  व्यापक पहल िुरू की  गई है ज्ञजसका उद्देश्य शिक्षा के  शलए मलटी -मोड एक्सेस को  समथध बनाने क े  शलए 
कडज्ञजटल/ऑनलाइन/ऑन-एयर शिक्षा से संबंशधत सभी प्रयासों को एकीकृत करना है।  इस पहल में व्यापक पहुंच 
प्रदान करने के  शलए सभी प्रकार के  कडज्ञजटल मोड जैसे दीक्षा (ऑनलाइन), स्ियं (ऑनलाइन), स्ियं प्रभा 
(टीिी), दूरदिधन और आकाििार्ी नेटिकध के  उपयोग सकहत अन्य टीिी चैनल िाशमल हैं। 
 
जहां कडज्ञजटल सुविधा (मोबाइल कडिाइस/डीटीएच टेलीविजन) उपलब्ध नहीं है, िहां शिक्षा मंत्रालय ने 
सामुदाशयक  रेकडयो स्टेिनों और सीबीएसई की  शिक्षा िार्ी नामक  पॉडकास्ट, शिक्षाशथधयों के  शनिास पर आपूशतध 
की  गई पाठ्यपुस्तक ें, िकधिीट, 21िीं सदी के  कौिल  संबंधी हैंडबुक  और समुदाय/ मोहलला कक्षाएं जैसी पहलें 
की  हैं।  समग्र शिक्षा के  तहत इनोिेिन फंड का  उपयोग दूरदराज  के  ग्रामीर् इलाकों  में जहां ऑनलाइन कक्षाएं 
मुज्ञश्कल हैं िहां मोबाइल स्कूल, िचुधअल स्टूकडयो, स्कूलों में िचुधअल क्लास रूम , राज्यों/ संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों के  
शलए सतत अशधगम योजना  (सीएलपी), विशभन्न राज्यों और संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों में प्री-लोडेड टैबलेट स्थावपत 
करने के  शलए ककया जाता है।   
 
 इसक े अलािा, अशधगम समाधानों के  शलए एक  िैकज्ञलपक िैक्षज्ञर्क कैलेंडर तैयार ककया  गया है ज्ञजसमें कक्षा 
1 से 12 तक  के  कडिाइस िाले और वबना कडिाइस िाले बच्चों के  शलए के  स्ि-मूलयांकन िाशमल है। आरटीई 
अशधशनयम, 2009 के  प्रािधानों के  तहत वििेष प्रशिक्षर् क ें द्रों (एसटीसी) में पढ रहे स्कूल ना जाने िाले बच्चों 
के  अशधगम अंतरालों को  कम करने  के  शलए विज कोसध मॉड्यूल भी विकशसत ककए  गए हैं।  इसक े अलािा, 
विशभन्न माध्यमों से शनरंतर शिक्षा की  सुविधा के  शलए राज्यों/संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों को  प्रिता कदिाशनदेि जारी ककए  
गए। कदिाशनदेिों में अन्य बातों के  साथ-साथ ऐसी ज्ञस्थशत िाशमल है जहां इंटरनेट कनेज्ञक्टविटी उपलब्ध नहीं है 
या बहुत कम  बैंडविड्थ के  साथ उपलब्ध है, िहां संसाधनों को  टेलीविजन, रेकडयो आकद जैसे विशभन्न प्लेटफामों 
के  माध्यम से साझा ककया  जाता है जो इंटरनेट पर शनभधर नहीं हैं। इसी तरह , कोविड -19 के  दौरान बच्चों के  
अशधगम में सहायता के  शलए छात्र अशधगम संिधधन कदिाशनदेि जारी ककए  गए थे। वििेष आिश्यकता िाले 
बच्चों के  शलए ई-कंटेंट के  विकास हेतु कदिा-शनदेि जारी ककए गए हैं। स्कूल बंद होने के  दौरान और उसक े  बाद 
घर-आधाररत शिक्षा में अशभभािकों की  भागीदारी के  शलए भी कदिा-शनदेि भी जारी ककए गए हैं।

3912 श्री िररमि नथिानीीः 
 
क्या िांचायती राज मांत्री यह बताने की क ृपा करेंगे कक : 
 
(क ) क्या सरकार ने िेश के पपछडे क्षेत्रों में बुननयािी ढांचे के पिकास और उन्नयन के ललए कोई योजना 
शुरू की है;  
(ख) यदि हां, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है; और 
(ग) पपछले तीन िर्षों में इस योजना  के तहत आिंदित और उपयोग की गई ननधध, यदि कोई हो, का 
राज्य/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र-िार ब्यौरा क्या है? 
 
उत्तर 
 िांचायती राज राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री िपिि मोऱेश्िर िाटीि) 
 
(क) से (ग): पंचायती राज मंत्रालय ने िेश के पपछडे क्षेत्रों में ब ुननयािी ढांचे के पिकास और उन्नयन के 
ललए कोई योजना श ुरू नहीं की है। तर्ापप , पंद्रहिें पित्त आयोग के तहत अनुिान ग्रामीण स्र्ानीय ननकायों 
को अन्य बातों के सार्-सार् संपिधान की  ग्यारहिीं अनुसूची में प्रनतष् ठापपत  29 पिर्षयों के तहत महसूस 
की गई जरूरतों के ललए उ पयोग हेतु जारी ककया जाता है जजसमें सभी क्षेत्रों के ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में सडक , 
प ुललया , प ुल , घाि, जलमागथ जैसे ब ुननयािी ढांचे शालमल हैं। पंचायतें प ूरी तरह से पित्त आयोग अनुिान से 
या अन्य योजनाओं जैसे महात्मा गांधी राष्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंिी योजना और ग्रामीण पिकास मंत्रालय 
की प्रधानमंत्री ग्राम सडक योजना के अलभसरण के माध्यम से ब ुननयािी ढांचे का ननमाथण और रखरखाि 
कर सकती हैं।  इसके अलािा , ग्रामीण पिकास मंत्रालय द्िारा िी गई सूचना के अन ुसार प्रधान मंत्री ग्राम 
सडक योजना (पीएमजीएसिाई) की क ें द्र प्रायोजजत योजना के तहत ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में सभी मौसम के अन ुक ूल 
सडक संपकथ लक्षक्षत आिास की पूरी आबािी तक पहुंच योग्य आिश्यकताओं को पूरा करने के ललए बनाया 
जा रहा है जजसके ललए राज्यों को पित्तीय सहायता प्रिान की जाती है। पीएमजीएसिाई के तहत ननलमथत 
सडक ें  समाज के सभी ि गों की जरूरतों को प ूरा करती हैं। किर भी , िेश के पपछडे क्षेत्रों जैसे अन ुसूधचत 
जनजानत और पपछडे जजलों को पिशेर्ष छ ूि िेकर योजना पर  पिशेर्ष ध्यान दिया गया है। पीएमजीएसिाई 
योजना के तहत जारी और उपयोग की गई राज्य/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र-िार ननधध का ब्यौरा अन ुबंध में है ।

आरजीएसए ि े अांतर्गत “सबिा साथ, सबिा र्ाांव, सबिा वविास ” अभभयान ि े  िायागन्वयन िी स्थथतत 
3913 श्री अयोध्या रामी रेड्डी आलााः 
क्या पांचायती राज मांत्री यह बताने की क ृपा करेंगे कक : 
 
(क ) ‘राष्ट्रीय ग्राम स्वराज अभभयान’ (आरजीएसए) क े अंतगथत ‘सबका सार्, सबका गां व, सबका ववकास ’ 
अभभयान क े  कायथ न्वयन की स्स्र्तत क्या है; 
(ख) क्या राज्यों ने आरजीएसए क े अंतगथत अपनी वावषथक योजनाओं में सतत ववकास लक्ष्यों को शाभमल 
ककया है, य दि हााँ, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है; और 
(ग ) क्या इस योजना की प्रभावकाररता का म ूलयांकन करने क े भलए कोई प्रभाव आकलन अध्ययन 
करवाया जा रहा है, यदि हााँ, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है? 
 
उत्तर 
 पांचायती राज राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री िवपल मोरेश्वर पाटील) 
 
(क ) मंत्रालय द्वारा राष्ट्रीय ग्राम स्वराज अभभयान (आरजीएसए) क े तहत "सबका सार्, सबका गांव , 
सबका ववकास" जैसा कोई अभभयान  शुरू  नहीं ककया  गया है। तर्ावप , मंत्रालय अगले वषथ क े भलए समावेशी 
और समग्र पंचायत ववकास योजना (पीडीपी) तैयार करने क े भलए सभी राज्यों/क ें द्र शाभसत प्रिेशों में हर 
वषथ 02 अक्टूबर से 31 दिसंबर तक जन योजना अभभयान (पीपीसी) 'सबकी योजना सबका ववकास ' चला

क् या सड़क पररवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्री यह बताने की कृपा करेंर्े कक:

(ख) यदि हां, तो राज्य-वार आंकड़ों सदहत तत्संबंिी ब्यौरा क्या है; 
(र्) क्या सरकार का आर्ामी पांच वर्षों में स्क्रैवपंर् सुवविा क ें द्रों की संख्या में ववस्क्तार करने का ववचार है; 
(घ) यदि हां, तो तत्संबंिी राज्य-वार और वर्षग-वार ब्यौरा क्या है; और 
(ङ) इसके भलए ककतनी िनराभश की आवश्यकता होर्ी और क्या वर्षग 2022 के भलए ननिागररत लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त 
करने के भलए वतगमान में सरकार के पास पयागप्त ननधि उपलब्ि है ?

सड़क पररवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्री

ननम्नभलखखत अधिसूचनाएं जारी की र्ई हैं और मंत्रालय की वेबसाइट पर अपलोड की र्ई हैं: -

ननयंत्रण से संबंधित है। यह अधिसूचना 25 भसतंबर , 2021 से प्रभावी हो र्ई है।

र्ई है।

(क)  क्या सरकार महहला उद्यममयों को प्रोत्साहन देने और आत्मविश्िास हामसल करने म ें

अंतगगत महहलाओं को ऋण प्रदान करने क े  मलए कदम उठा रही है ;

उत्तर 
ग्रामीण विकास राज्य मंत्री 
(साध्िी रनरंजन ज्योरत) 
(क) : िर्षग 2013-14 से अब तक दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना - राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण आजीविका ममशन 
(डीएिाई -एनआरएलएम) क े  तहत  स्ियं सहायता समूहों को  4.71 लाख करोड़ रुपये से अधधक क े  
ब ैंक ऋण प्राप्त करने में सहायता की गई है।  िर्षग 2013-14 से ऐसे सभी ब ैंक ऋणों पर ब्याज 
सहायता भी दी जा रही है , जजससे प ू
ंजी की लागत कम हो रही है। डीएिाई -एनआरएलएम 
राज्यों/संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों से प्राप्त आिश्यकताओं क े  अनु
सार एसएचजी ब ैंक मलंक े ज पर राज्यों/संघ 
राज्य क्षेत्रों में ब ैंकरों को प्रमशक्षण/उन्मु
खीकरण प्रदान करता है। महहला स्ियं सहायता सम ू
हों को 
ऋण प्रदान करने क े  मलए हदशाननदेश 
प्रत्येक िर्षग भारतीय ररजिग बैंक द्िारा जारी ककए जाते ह ैं। 
इसक े  अलािा, यह  मंत्रालय डीएिाई-एनआरएलएम क े  तहत एक उप -योजना क े  रूप म ें स्टाटग-अप 
ग्राम उद्यममता कायगक्रम (एसिीईपी) को कायागजन्ित कर रहा है। ब्लॉक एसिीईपी क े  कायागन्ियन 
की इकाई है। इस योजना का उद्देश्य ग्रामीण गरीबों (एसएचजी) को गैर -क ृवर्ष क्षेत्रों में ग्रामीण 
स्तर पर उद्यम स्थावपत करने में मदद करना है। स्टाटग -अप पूंजी प्रदान करने क े  अलािा

राज्य नोडऱ खाते में जार  करने में विऱॊब  क े  कारण मकानों क े  लनमाषण में देर  ह ुई। राज्यों/सॊघ

(क ) क्या सरकार ने िर्ग 2020-21 क े  दौरान ‘मनरेगा ’ क े  अंतगगत आिंटन को जानबूझकर

(ख) क्या सरकार को इस बात की जानकारी है कक ऱंवबत वबऱों में 20,000 करोड़ रु. से अलधक

ककए गए कायग कदिसों की संख्या की तुऱना में ऱगभग आधा कर देगा ; और 
(ग) िर्ग 2021-22 क े  लऱए स्िीकृत 27 करोड़ कायग कदिसों क े  सृजन को बढाकर 35 करोड़ कायग 
कदिस करने क े  ऩजिमी बंगाऱ क े  अनुरोध ऩर सरकार की क्या प्रलतकिया है?  
  
उत्तर 
ग्रामीण विकास राज्य मंत्री 
(साध्िी लनरंजन ज्योलत)

वित्तीय िर्ग 2021-22 में बजट अनुमान चरण में बजट प्रािधान 73,000 करोड़ रू. था। 
इस मंत्राऱय ने अलतररक्त बजट आिंटन का अनुरोध ककया था जजसे लनलधयों की आिश्यकता क े

मंत्राऱय से महात्मा गांधी नरेगा योजना क े  अंतगगत अलतररक्त लनलधयों की मांग करता है।

‘मनरेगा’ क े  अंतगगत सामाजजक अंक े ऺण  
3946. श्री नीरज शेखर्   
 
क्या ग्रामीण विकास मंत्री यह बताने की कृऩा करेंगे कक्  
  
(क ) क्या विगत तीन वित्तीय िर्षों क े  दौरान विलभन्न राज्यों में ‘मनरेगा’ क े  अंतगगत सामाजजक 
अंक े ऺण का प्रलतशत ऱक्ष्य की तुऱना में बहुत कम है ; 
  
(ख) यकद हां, तो तत्संबंधी राज्य-िार और िर्षग-िार ब्यौरा क्या है; 
  
(ग) 
‘मनरेगा’ क े  अंतगगत राज्य-िार कम सामाजजक अंक े ऺण ककए जाने क े  क्या कारण हैं ; और 
  
(घ) सरकार ने  ‘मनरेगा’ क े  अंतगगत शत-प्रलतशत सामाजजक अंक े ऺण ककया जाना सुलनजित 
करने क े  लऱए क्या उऩाय ककए हैं ? 
  
उत्तर 
ग्रामीण विकास राज्य मंत्री 
(साध्िी लनरंजन ज्योलत) 
  
(क ) से (ग): वित्तीय िर्षग 2018-19, 2019-20 और 2020-21 क े  दौरान महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय 
ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी योजना (महात्मा गांधी नरेगा योजना) क े  अंतगगत सामाजजक अंक े ऺण का 
राज्य/संघ राज्य ऺेत्र-िार ब्यौरा अनुबंध-I में कदया गया है। 
  
सामाजजक अंक े ऺण ऩूरा करने की अलनिायग प्रकियाएं ग्राम सभा आयोजजत करना है। कोविड - 19 
महामारी क े  कारण ऱोगों क े  स्िास््य की सुरऺा की दृवि से एक स्थान ऩर कई ऱोगों क े  एकत्र 
होने को बढािा नहीं कदया गया। राज्य /संघ राज्य ऺेत्र क े िऱ कुछ ही ऺेत्रों में सामाजजक 
अंक े ऺण कर सक े  जहां ग्राम सभा आयोजजत करने की अनुमलत कोविड कदशालनदेशों में दी गई। 
इन ऩररजस्थलतयों में राज्यों/संघ राज्य ऺेत्रों ने समिती अंक े ऺण आयोजजत कीं। वित्तीय िर्षग 
2020-
21 क े  दौरान महात्मा गांधी नरेगा योजना क े  अंतगगत समिती सामाजजक अंक े ऺण का 
राज्य/संघ राज्य ऺेत्र-िार ब्यौरा अनुबंध-II में कदया गया है। 
   
 
711

 
(घ): सामाजजक अंक े ऺण क े  लऱए अंक े ऺण मानक जारी कर कदए गए हैं और राज्यों /संघ राज्य 
ऺेत्रों को स्ितंत्र सामाजजक अंक े ऺण इकाइयां स्थावऩत करने , योजना की अंक े ऺण लनयमािऱी , 
2011 क े  अनुसार सामाजजक अंक े ऺण आयोजजत करने और सामाजजक अंक े ऺण करने क े  लऱए 
ग्राम संसाधन व्यवियों को प्रलशऺण देने की सऱाह दी गई है। राज्यों/संघ राज्य ऺेत्रों को सख्त 
और गुणित्ताऩूणग सामाजजक अंक े ऺण करने क े  लऱए एसएयू क े  अंतगगत ऩयागप्त कालमगक भती करने 
की भी सऱाह दी गई है।   
 इस योजना क े  कायागन्ियन में महत्िऩूणग सुधार करने क े  उद्देश्य से वित्तीय िर्षग 2022-
23 क े  लऱए राज्यों/संघ राज्य ऺेत्रों की िावर्षगक कायग योजना और श्रम बजट शुरू करने क े  लऱए 
कुछ ऩूिग-शतग लनधागररत करने का लनणगय लऱया गया है अथागत (i ) एक स्ितंत्र लनदेशक क े  अधीन 
स्ितंत्र एसएयू बनाई जाए ( ii ) जजन ग्राम ऩंचायतों की वित्तीय िर्षग 2019-20 में सामाजजक 
अंक े ऺण नहीं की गई है, उन सभी ग्राम ऩंचायतों की अंक े ऺण की जाए और ( iii ) अंक े ऺण में 
दशागई गई देय िसूलऱयों क े  कम-से-कम 50% की िसूऱी की जाए। राज्यों /संघ राज्य ऺेत्रों की 
सामाजजक अंक े ऺण संबंधी लनष्ऩादन को ध्यान में रखते हुए उनका श्रम बजट स्िीकृत ककया

कामागन्िमन की आिलधक लनगयानी कयती हैं।

कामागन्िमन की सभीऺा कयने क े  लरए लनमलभत अंतयार ऩय याज्मों/संघ याज्म ऺेत्रों का 
दौया कयते हैं। ऺेत्रीम दौयों क े  ऩश्चात लनष्कर्षग, कलभमां तथा लसपारयिें याज्म/संघ याज्म 
ऺेत्रों क े  साथ साझा की जाती हैं ताकक िे उऩमुक्त कायगिाई कय सक ें ।

लरए बौगोलरक सूचना प्रणारी ( जीआईएस) का उऩमोग कय यहा है। जीआईएस आमोजना का 
उऩमोग भहात्भा गांधी याष्ट्रीम ग्राभीण योजगाय गायंट  मोजना (भनयेगा) औय प्रधान भंत्री ग्राभ 
सड़क मोजना (ऩीएभजीएसिाई) क े  लरए ककमा जा यहा है।  
ऩीएभजीएसिाई-III क े  अंतगात, 7.70 राख से अलधक ग्राभीण सुविधाओं जैसे लचककत्सा , शैक्षऺक 
औय फाजायों को क्षजमो -टैग ककमा गमा है। ग्राभीण सड़कों का ब्मौया ऩक्षब्रक डोभेन भें  
https://geosadak-pmgsy.nic.in/opendata ऩय उऩरब्ध है। ऩीएभजीएसिाई याष्ट्रीम जीआईएस 
733

कदशालनदेश क े  तहत तैमाय ककमा गमा जीआईएस डाटा न क े िर ग्राभीण ऺेत्रों का है , फक्षकक शहय  
ऺेत्रों, याष्ट्रीम याजभागों, याज्म याजभागों औय येरिे ऩटरयमों इत्माकद सकहत सभग्र याष्ट्रीम बू-
स्थालनक डाटासेट क े  रूऩ भें कामा कयता है। क्षजमोसड़क को ऩूय  तयह से स्िदेशी जीआईएस डाटा 
रेमय औय सैटेराइट डाटा सेिाओं का उऩमोग कयक े  विकलसत ककमा गमा है।    
भहात्भा गांधी नयेगा मोजना क े  अंतगात देश बय भें जर संग्रहण , सूखा याहत , फाढ़ लनमंत्रण 
कामाकराऩों, स्िच्छता से संफंलधत ऩरयसंऩवत्तमां सृक्षजत की जाती हैं। भोफाइर आधारयत क्षजमो-
टैलगंग क े  उऩमोग क े  भाध्मभ से सैटेराइट से प्राप् स्थान आधारयत सेिाओं का उऩमोग िावषाक 
रूऩ से रगबग  7-8 लभलरमन ऩरयसंऩवत्तमों की आमोजना औय लनगयानी क े  लरए ककमा जा यहा है। 
ऑनराइन बू -
स्थालनक भानलचत्र  https://bhuvan-app2.nrsc.gov.in/mgnrega/mgnrega_ 
phase2.php ऩय उऩरब्ध है। देश बय भें सबी भनयेगा कामों क े  लरए क्षजमोटैग फनाने क े  लरए 
एक िेफ जीआईएस आधारयत तंत्र फह ुत सपर है औय िताभान भें  3 कयोड़ संऩवत्तमों को क्षजमोटैग 
ककमा गमा है।  
भनयेगा क े  अंतगात , 2.56 राख ग्राभ ऩंचामतों (जीऩी) ने  31 भाचा 2022 तक जीआईएस आधारयत 
जीऩी मोजनाएं तैमाय की हैं। ऩीएभजीएसिाई - III क े  तहत , 11537 स्िीक ृ त सड़क प्रस्ताि 
(87026.04 कक .भी. रंफी ) जीआईएस (क्षजमोसड़क) प्रेटपॉभा ऩय तैमाय ककए गए हैं।      
भनयेगा मोजना क े  किमान्िमन भें फेहतय ऩायदलशाता सुलनक्षित कयने क े  लरए ऺेत्र अलधकाय  ऐऩ 
औय नेशनर भोफाइर भॉलनटरयंग सॉफ्टिेमय जैसे भोफाइर ऐक्षप्रक े शन विकलसत ककए गए हैं। 
अलधकाय  ऐऩ लनय ऺण कयने िारे अलधकारयमों को लनय ऺण क े  लनष्कषों को ऑनराइन कयने भें 
सऺभ फनाता है। नेशनर भोफाइर भॉलनटरयंग सॉफ्टिेमय प्रत्मेक कामा क े  लरए कदन भें दो फाय 
उऩक्षस्थलत रेने भें सऺभ फनाता है क्षजसभें एक सभम भें  20 से अलधक श्रलभकों क े  लरए भस्टय 
योर जाय  ककमा गमा है। उऩमुाक्त सबी ऐप्स भें  क्षजमो-
टैग ककए जाने क े  सभम िारा पोटोग्राप 
लरए जाते हैं , क्षजनकी तुरना संफंलधत कामा की साइट क े  जीआईएस लनदेशांक से की जाती है। 
ऩीएभजीएसिाई कामों क े  लनय ऺण क े  सभम बी इसी तयह की कायािाई की जाती है।  
प्रधान भंत्री आिास मोजना-ग्राभीण, श्माभा प्रसाद भुखजी रूफान लभशन क े  अंतगात बी  ऩरयसंऩवत्तमों 
को क्षजमो-टैग ककमा गमा है। प्रधानभंत्री आिास मोजना-ग्राभीण भें  5 क्षजमोटैग ककए जाने क े  
सभम क े  साथ तस्िीयें री गई हैं , ताकक मह सुलनक्षित ककमा जा सक े  कक लनलध का कह ं औय 
उऩमोग कयक े  मोजना सहामता का द ुरुऩमोग न हो।     
(घ)    ऩीएभजीएसिाई क े  अंतगात, संऩूणा क्षजरा ग्राभीण सड़क मोजना (ड आयआयऩी) , आिास औय 
भहत्िऩूणा साभाक्षजक-आलथाक सुविधाओं को जीआईएस ऩय क्षजमो -टैग ककमा गमा है औय 
734

ऩरयमोजनाओं की फेहतय आमोजना औय लनगयानी क े  लरए उऩमोग ककमा जा यहा है। 
ऩीएभजीएसिाई-III भें याष्ट्रीम ग्राभीण अिसंयचना विकास एजेंसी (एनआयआईड ए ) ने ट्रेस भैप्स

ग्राभीण विकास याज्म भॊत्री 
(साध्िी लनयॊजन ज्मोलत) 
  
(क ) औय (ख): ग्राभीण विकास भॊत्रारम विलबन्न मोजनाओॊ क े  अॊतगयत कामयक्रभों/ऩरयमोजनाओँ क े  
रक्षऺत कामायन्िमन औय सभमफद्ध सभाऩन ऩय जोय देता है। मोजनाओॊ का सभमफद्ध सभाऩन 
सुलनक्षित कयने क े  उद्देश्म से भॊत्रारम ने ग्राभीण विकास मोजनाओँ क े  कामायन्िमन की लनगयानी 
औय भूलमाॊकन क े  लरए विलबन्न स्तयों औय पॉभेटों िारी व्माऩक व्मिस्था तैमाय की है, क्षजसभें 
लनष्ऩादन सभीऺा सलभलत की फैठक ें, क्षजरा विकास सभन्िम औय लनगयानी सलभलत ( “कदशा”) की 
फैठक ें, याष्ट्रीम स्तय क े  लनगयानीकताय (एनएरएभ ) , ऺेत्र अलधकायी मोजनाएॊ, साझा सभीऺा लभशन , 
सभिती भूलमाॊकन औय प्रबाि लनधाययण अध्ममन शालभर हैं। इसक े  अलतरयक्त, ग्राभीण विकास 
भॊत्रारम की मोजनाओॊ को एॊड -टू-एॊड ट्ाॊजेक्शन आधारयत एभआईएस भें शालभर ककमा गमा है ,

क्षजससे सबी कहतधायक तत्कार आधाय ऩय मोजनाओॊ की क्षस्थलत की लनगयानी कय ऩाते हैं। 
लनभायण कामों क े  क्षजमो-टैग औय टाइभ स्टैंऩ िारे पोटो लरए जाते हैं।      
  
उऩमुयक्त क े  अरािा, भॊत्रारम ऩमायप् लनलधमों औय िन विबाग की भॊजूरयमों की व्मिस्था कयता है, 
क्षजसक े  लरए अन्म भॊत्रारमों/विबागों क े  साथ सभमफद्ध तयीक े  से सभन्िम की आिश्मकता होती 
है, ताकक कामों का सभाऩन हो। भहात्भा गाॉधी याष्ट्रीम ग्राभीण योजगाय गायॊटी मोजना (भहात्भा 
गाॉधी नयेगा) औय प्रधान भॊत्री आिास मोजना-ग्राभीण (ऩीएभएिाई-जी) जैसी मोजनाओँ क े  लरए 
साभाक्षजक रेखा ऩयीऺाएॊ बी कयाई जाती हैं औय भहात्भा गाॉधी नयेगा कामों क े  विर्षम भें ककसी 
बी लशकामत ऩय काययिाई कयने क े  लरए रोकऩार की लनमुवक्त की जाती है।   
  
(ग): भॊत्रारम ने िास्तविक औय वित्तीम प्रगलत की ऑनराइन लनगयानी क े  लरए अनेक 
प्रौद्योलगककमों, भोफाइर ऐऩ सकहत आईसीटी सभाधानों तथा ग्राभीण विकास क े  फेहतय कामायन्िमन 
सॊफॊधी कदशालनदेशों को अऩनामा है, क्षजनका ब्मौया इस प्रकाय है: 
  
(i) भहात्भा गाॉधी नयेगा मोजना क े  अॊतगयत, योजगाय की ग्राभीण दयों क े  आधाय ऩय अनुभान 
ऩरयकरन का सॉफ्टिेमय (लसक्मोय) तैमाय ककमा गमा है , क्षजसका उद्देश्म नयेगासॉफ्ट क े  भाध्मभ से 
इस मोजना क े  अॊतगयत कामय का अनुभान तैमाय कयना औय सृक्षजत कामों क े  
तकनीकी/ प्रशासलनक(वित्तीम) अनुभोदन प्रदान कयना है;    
       
(ii) नई साभग्री/अऩलशष्ट साभग्री/स्थानीम स्तय ऩय उऩरब्ध साभग्री का प्रमोग कयते हुए ग्राभीण 
सड़कों क े  लनभायण भें ककपामती औय तीव्र लनभायण प्रौद्योलगककमों को फढािा देने क े  उद्देश्म से प्रधान 
भॊत्री ग्राभ सड़क मोजना (ऩीएभजीएसिाई
) क े  अॊतगयत „प्रौद्योलगकीम ऩहरों सॊफॊधी कदशालनदेश‟ जायी 
ककए गए हैं। ऩीएभजीएसिाई भें प्रमोग की गई कुछ भहत्िऩूणय प्रौद्योलगककमों भें सेर कपलड कॊक्रीट, 
ऩैनलड सीभेंट कॊक्रीट, योरय से कम्ऩैक्ट ककए ह ुए कॊक्रीट ऩेिभेंट , सीभेंट क्षस्थयीकयण, टेयाजाइभ, 
कोलड लभक्स प्रौद्योलगकी, अऩलशष्ट प्राक्षस्टक का प्रमोग, सयप े स ड्रेलसॊग औय पुर-डेप्थ रयक्रेभेशन 
(एपडीआय) शालभर हैं।  
(iii) स्थानीम बू-जरिामु ऩरयक्षस्थलतमों क े  अनुकूर आऩदा-योधी विशेर्षताओॊ को शालभर कयने िारी 
भकान कडजाइन श्रेक्षणमों क े  विकलऩों क े  ऩहर सॊग्रह क े  भाध्मभ से ऩीएभएिाई-जी क े  अॊतगयत 
भकान क े  लनभायण भें राबालथयमों की सहामता की जा यही है। सभमफद्ध तयीक े  से भकानों क े  
गुणित्ताऩूणय लनभायण क े  लरए याज्मों/सॊघ याज्म ऺेत्रों से अच्छी गुणित्ता िारी लनभायण साभग्री की 
उऩरब्धता सुलनक्षित कयने को कहा गमा है। विलबन्न स्तयों ऩय कामायन्िमन क े  भुद्दों की सूक्ष्भ 
लनगयानी भें सहामता क े  लरए डैशफोडय विकलसत ककमा गमा है।

(क ): श्माभा प्रसाद भुखजी रूफगन लभशन (एसऩीएभआयएभ) क े  अंतगगत विगत तीन िर्षों भें गुजयात 
याज्म को रयरीज औय व्मम की गई लनलधमों का िर्षग-िाय ब्मौया अनुफंध-1 भें कदमा गमा है।

क े  अंतगगत ककए गए कामों का िर्षग-िाय ब्मौया अनुफंध-2 भें कदमा गमा है।  
(ग) औय (घ):  एसऩीएभआयएभ क े  अंतगगत क्रस्ियों का विकास आधायबूत प्रािधान, आलथगक, 
साभाज्ञजक औय कडज्ञजिर अिसंयचना सुविधाओं को शालभर कयते हुए 21 घिकों क े  भाध्मभ से ककमा 
जाता है। शहयी प्रिास से संफंलधत कोई बी डािा भंत्रारम नहीं यखता है। तथावऩ, िर्षग 2020 भें नीलत 
आमोग, डीएभईओ द्वाया संऩाकदत ग्राभीण विकास ऺेत्रों भें क ें द्रीम प्रामोज्ञजत मोजनाओं क े  भूलमांकन क े  
लनष्कर्षग क े  अनुसाय एसऩीएभआयएभ याष्ट्रीम संदबग क े  अनुरूऩ है औय ऩरयितगनकायी विकास सुलनज्ञित 
कयने क े  लरए फेहद प्रासंलगक है। इसक े  अरािा, एसऩीएभआयएभ ‘शहयों से िाऩस गांिों की ओय’ को 
फढािा देकय शहयी प्रिास को योकता है क्मोंकक फुलनमादी संयचना औय सुविधाएं प्रदान की जाती हैं 
औय औद्योलगकीकयण को फढािा कदमा जाता है। इससे रुफगन ऺेत्रों भें योजगाय क े  अिसयों भें धीये-धीये 
िृवि होती हैं।

(क ) औय (ख): ग्राभीण विकास भंत्रारम ने स्िणा जमंती ग्राभ स्ियोजगाय मोजना 
(एसजीएसिाई) क े  अंतगात फैंक ऋण से संफंलधत भुद्दों की जांच कयने तथा प्रदामगी प्रणारी की 
कलभमों को साभने राने क े  लरए अप्रैर , 2008 भें याधाक ृ ष्ण सलभलत गकित की थी।  
एसजीएसिाई क े  संफंध भें इस सलभलत क े  क ु छ प्रभुख लनष्कर्ा लनम्नानुसाय हैं:-  
i. ऋण स्िीक ृ लत भें विरंफ, फैंकों क े  असहमोग तथा उलचत भागदशान की कभी से क ु छ   
सभस्माएं ऩैदा हो यह  थीं।  
ii. फैंक शाखाओं औय ब्रॉक अलधकारयमों क े  फीच तारभेर का अबाि था।

iii. ऋण स्िीक ृ त कयने क े  फाद कोई प्रबािी लनगयानी नह ं की जा यह  थी।   
iv. एसजीएसिाई क े  अंतगात सभग्र ि े किट उऩरब्ब्ध फहुत कभ थी तथा लनधाारयत ि े किट  
रक्ष्मों औय िास्ति भें जुटाई गई ि े किट भें रगाताय अंतय था।  
v. वित्तीम सेिाओं भें गय फों क े  अनुक ू र प्रणालरमां औय प्रकिमाएं नह ं थीं।  
vi. फैंक शाखाओं औय कभाचारयमों की कभ संख्मा क े  कायण ि े किट प्रिाह फुय  तयह से 
प्रबावित था।  
 
(ग) औय (घ):  भूलमांकन क े  लनष्कर्ा स्िीकाय कय लरए गए थे औय  याधाक ृ ष्ण सलभलत की 
लसपारयशों क े  आधाय ऩय स्िणा जमंती ग्राभ स्ियोजगाय मोजना (एसजीएसिाई) को द नदमार 
अंत्मोदम मोजना - याष्ट्रीम ग्राभीण आजीविका लभशन (ि एिाई-एनआयएरएभ ) भें ऩुनगाकित कय 
कदमा गमा औय इसे कदनांक 03 जून, 2011 को शुरू ककमा गमा। दो िर्ा क े  ऩरयितानकार  क े  फाद 
एसजीएसिाई 01 अप्रैर, 2013 से अब्स्तत्ि भें नह ं है। िताभान कामािभ का उद्देश्म याधा क ृ ष्ण 
सलभलत द्वाया फताए गए सबी अबािों औय कलभमों को द ूय कयना है। ि एिाई -एनआयएरएभ का 
उद्देश्म ग्राभीण गय फ भकहराओं की जभीनी स्तय ऩय भजफूत औय स्थामी संस्थाओं का लनभााण 
कयना तथा उन्हें संसाधन औय राबकाय  स्ियोजगाय क े  लरए जानकाय , क ु शर भजद ूय  योजगाय 
क े  अिसय प्राप्त कयने भें सभऺ फनाना है ब्जससे उनकी आम भें स्थामी रूऩ से भहत्िऩूणा िृवि 
हो। कदनांक 28 पयिय , 2022 की ब्स्थलत क े  अनुसाय ि एिाई-एनआयएरएभ क े  अंतगात 8.16

िर्ष 2021-22 तक  (पयियी 2022 तक ) भकिरा स्िमं सिामता सभूिों द्वाया प्राप्त याज्म-िाय फैंक 
ऋण का ब्मौया अनुफंध-I भें कदमा गमा िै

िाय संख्मा दशाषने िारा विियण अनुफंध-II  भें कदमा गमा िै।
